svg.title: Test how well a model follows an extra rule
svg.desc: A quick choice may work for one rule. A second rule can change the right answer. Use the same cards when comparing settings. One rule. The cards are red, blue and gold. The request asks for red. Add an exception. Now there is a red star, a red dot and a blue dot. Keep red cards unless they carry a star. Check the result. Only the red dot qualifies. If a setting missed the exception, try the same input with a different effort setting.
